body:
alana: Noticing missing aggregate rows for 2026-03-15 01:00-01:30 UTC from legacy ETL. Looks like a delayed S3 write caused late events. Need to run a small, targeted replay.

josh: Which partitions/shards are affected? can we scope it?

alana: shards 21 and 22; window ~2026-03-15T01:00:00Z to 2026-03-15T01:30:00Z. Estimated raw rows ~65k.

pri: full backfill will be heavy. prefer: preflight -> dry-run -> deduped replay with quota guard. console should show per-shard token and an "allow override" toggle.

leia: UX point: add a small inline warning if the replay will touch Dedicated burst capacity and require on-call approval. also show slot_seconds.

ejan: infra note: priority lanes map to dedicated pools; fallback to standard pool is enabled but currently strips X-Idempotency-Key. that can cause duplicates on fallback.

josh: we hit that before. can we add a router fix to propagate X-Idempotency-Key immediately?

ejan: yes, I'll ship a tiny middleware today. low risk.

replay-bot: preflight requested by alana at 1758122380. command: `/replay preflight --shards 21,22 --since 2026-03-15T01:00Z --until 2026-03-15T01:30Z`

replay-bot: preflight result: shard21=18.9k tokens, shard22=15.7k tokens. total_tokens=34.6k. est_duplicates=~900. slot_seconds=260.

pri: under soft limit. we can proceed as targeted. console should allow setting quota_override up to 40k with explicit approval from on-call.

josh: I'll take ownership of the handoff and watch the run. I'll require on-call if preflight > 50k.

replay-bot: dry-run scheduled by josh at 1758122440. command: `/replay run --mode dry-run --shards 21,22 --since 2026-03-15T01:00Z --until 2026-03-15T01:30Z`

replay-bot: dry-run complete. duplicates_detected=897. token_estimate=34.5k. no schema drift.

alana: ok go for live replay in 10m. josh will start with dedupe and quota_override=38k. remember route fallback policy and keep watch on latency panels.

replay-bot: live replay started (job id r-20260315-210). routing: priority=low-latency -> fallback=standard.

leia: monitoring: per-shard QPS ok, burst pool usage at 22%. will update if it climbs.

replay-bot: mid-run alert: shard22 encountered transient s3 timeout; job retried 2x, router preserved X-Idempotency-Key. no duplicate inserts detected.

josh: thanks for the router fix, ejan. that prevented duplicates.

replay-bot: job finished at 1758123520. tokens_used=34,240; duplicates_removed=888; no SLO breach.

alana: great. post-run follow-ups: (1) add shard-token breakdown to console preflight UI (leia), (2) router middleware PR merged (ejan), (3) add this run to runbook examples (josh).

leia: I'll mock the UI and include the explicit approval modal text.

pri: i'll add a small verification query to the runbook to compare aggregate counts and open a rollback ticket if mismatch >0.5%.

alana: closing thread 1 — thanks everyone."
